## Audit Report: מרחק אבסולוטי abs() Implementation

I found **two regressions** in the generated code where the new computed field uses stale stored values instead of freshly computed ones.

**new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_panuy_ent1.dart:51** · abs() uses wrong field index · P1 (wrong result) · use `_m_abs((num.tryParse(_v[2] ?? '') ?? 0)  -  (num.tryParse(_v[4] ?? '') ?? 0))` instead of `_m_abs((num.tryParse(_v[8] ?? '') ?? 0))`

**new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_panuy_ent1.dart:174** · display uses stale computed value · P1 (wrong result) · recompute from source fields same as line 51 fix

### What went wrong:
The spec says `מרחק אבסולוטי = abs(הפרש רוחב)` (absolute distance = absolute value of latitude difference). The generator correctly created the function `_m_abs()` at line 17, but both the save logic (line 51) and display logic (line 174) fetch the abs input from `_v[8]` — the **stored** value of the latitude difference field — instead of recomputing from the **current** latitude and my-latitude fields (`_v[2] - _v[4]`).

This breaks two ways:
- **New record:** _v[8] is empty → abs(0) = 0 instead of the correct latitude delta
- **Edited record:** _v[8] has the old stored value → shows/saves the old absolute distance, not the newly edited one

All other computed fields in the same screen (c22, c24, c25, c26) correctly recompute from source fields; c23 breaks this pattern by indexing a computed field instead.

**Verified correct:** _m_abs() function is valid Dart (num.abs() method exists); no side effects to other apps (only panuy uses abs); police gates and compilation pass (they don't validate formula correctness, only syntax).

Report written to `./_audit-regression.md`.
